subject: english
question: Which of the following is the most appropriate title for the passage?

options.text: The Best Ways to Improve Your Habits
The Benefits of a High-Protein Diet for Muscle Building
A Note to My Future Self
The Benefits of Meditation for a Healthier Life

solution:
The correct answer is **"The Benefits of Meditation for a Healthier Life". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage narrates the personal experience of someone who moved to the city and initially enjoyed the fast pace of life but soon felt overwhelmed and anxious.
 
• The individual then discovers meditation, which significantly improves their mental and physical health.
 
• The author describes how starting a meditation practice led to feeling less anxious, sleeping better, and having more control over their thoughts and emotions.
 
• This positive change also inspired the author to adopt other healthy habits, like eating healthier and exercising more.
 
• The main focus of the passage is on how meditation served as a catalyst for significant personal improvement and well-being, making Option 4 the most fitting title.
 
• It encompasses the overall theme and message of the passage, which is to highlight the positive impact of meditation on one's life.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 4". **
